svg.title: From inculto to florere
svg.desc: Five plots of ground in a row, each a stage of cultivation. An untidy scribble on dry stony ground (inculto); one clear seedling kept from the scribble (serere, to sow); a young plant with two branches marked for cutting (putare, to prune, and to think); the plant with a branch from elsewhere bound onto it (inserere, to graft); and the plant painted in full colour, flowering and bearing fruit (florere).
svg.text: to till · to tend · to inhabit · to honour
